children.text: Collaborating with Professor Michael Coughlin on developing a Rust-based logging middleware to capture and structure event streams for astronomical alert brokering. Building tools for real-time event tracking and observability within Linux-based data processing pipelines.

responsibilities: Develop Rust-based logging middleware for event stream management
Build tools for real-time event tracking and observability
Design APIs to support structured data ingestion and analytics workflows
Implement backend logic for data integration and analytics-ready workflows

Contributed to cutting-edge observational data research
